task: Implement the MoMorph screen "Thể lệ UPDATE" (b1Filzi9i6) as the /standards route, with its editorial content served from the local Supabase project.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /standards renders the Thể lệ drawer panel with title, the 4 hero-badge tiers, the 6 collectible icons, the KUDOS QUỐC DÂN section and a footer holding Đóng + Viết KUDOS
All editorial copy on the panel is read from Postgres (public.rule_sections / public.rule_items) at request time, not hardcoded in TSX
The new tables carry RLS with a <table>_select_all policy for anon+authenticated, matching the F004 precedent
supabase/seed.sql seeds every rule row verbatim from the Figma frame; no invented copy
Clicking Đóng returns the viewer to the previous page (history back), falling back to / on a direct visit
The panel body scrolls independently while the footer stays pinned
Below the 553px design width the drawer occupies the full viewport width
e2e/the-le.spec.ts passes under the anon project via npx playwright test e2e/the-le.spec.ts --project=anon
npm run lint and npm run typecheck both exit 0
blastRadius: playwright.config.ts anon testMatch regex is edited — a malformed regex silences existing anon specs
supabase/seed.sql gains a section — a syntax error there breaks supabase db reset for every suite
lib/i18n/messages/dictionary.ts gains a namespace — vi.ts and en.ts must both be updated or tsc fails
lib/supabase/database.types.ts is regenerated wholesale by npm run db:types
app/standards/page.tsx currently renders ComingSoon; the footer link and the floating widget both point at it
contracts: public read RLS: create policy "<table>_select_all" ... for select to anon, authenticated using (true) — binding precedent from docs/system/permissions.md
queries.ts holds typed Supabase reads only; <feature>-data.ts orchestrates and maps rows to a frozen view model
Dictionary namespaces are added to dictionary.ts plus a vi-<feature>.ts and en-<feature>.ts pair wired into vi.ts/en.ts
e2e Vietnamese copy is asserted through exported constants in e2e/fixtures/, never inline literals
baseURL stays http://127.0.0.1:3000; Supabase local must be running before any e2e run
